ETag.description: The version of the resource, in quotes.

IdempotencyKey.description: A string of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters. A request with the same key and the same body gets the first answer again.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IfMatch.description: The ETag of the version that the request replaces. A version that does not match answers 412.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

IfMatchRequired.description: The ETag of the version that the request replaces. The request needs it: without it the answer is 428. A version that does not match answers 412.
IfMatchRequired.name: If-Match

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value. Only the operator sets the field that holds it. A request that holds the field is refused.
Any JSON value. Only the operator sets the field that holds it. A request that holds the field is refused.

items.description: Any JSON value. Only the operator sets the field that holds it. A request that holds the field is refused.

errorArgs.description: The arguments of the text of the error.

errorCode.description: A stable code for a program. A 403 for a missing permission, an address outside the IP allowlist, a missing CSRF header or a request from another site has one: access.denied, access.ip-not-allowed, session.csrf or session.other-site.

bearerAuth.description: An access token or a session of the console.

info.description: The tool-neutral REST API of an OpenDustpan server. The description covers the paths under /api/dustpan/v1/ only. A body has the schema of the Go type that the route names.
info.title: OpenDustpan REST API
